page.content:
First Mayor of Terminus, hero of the early crises.

How Salvor Hardin connects

  • Faction: First Foundation — Hardin leads Terminus as mayor through early crises.
  • Work: Foundation (book) — Salvor Hardin carries the first book's Terminus crises.
  • Event: First Crisis — Hardin solves the First Crisis without firing.

What is Salvor Hardin?

Salvor Hardin is the mayor who sees that Terminus's real weapon is science-as-religion and diplomacy, not the Encyclopedia's neutrality.

Key threads lead to First Foundation, Foundation (book) and First Crisis.
